ex.en: It's impolite to stare at people.

ex.en: We ate with chopsticks in restrained silence.

ex.en: A cup of coffee cleared my head.

ex.ja: それからすっきりきれいにしてくれ。
ex.en: Then clean it really well.

ex.en: How fluently he speaks English!

ex.en: Susie sat up until midnight, when she heard a strange noise.

ex.ja: 自動車は角をすれすれに通った。
ex.en: The car just shaved the corner.

m.g: continuously; the whole time; all the way; throughout
much (more); (by) far; far and away; a lot

ex.en: I've been waiting since six o'clock and still my turn hasn't come.

ex.ja: この時計はあれよりもずっと高価だ。
ex.en: This clock is far more expensive than that.

ex.ja: この慣習は、ずっと前から廃止されている。
ex.en: This practice has long since been done away with.

(falling) little by little; (slipping) gradually; (drawing back) slowly; with a slither
on and on; while putting off; slovenly; interminably

ex.en: I slithered down the muddy slope.

ex.ja: せめて日常会話ができるくらいになりたい。
ex.en: At the very least, I'd like to be able to have everyday conversations.

ex.ja: そいつはぼくの神経にさわる。
ex.en: It gets on my nerves.

ex.en: It is going to rain soon.

ex.en: That makes you even more attractive.

m.g: then (of some incident just spoken of); that (of point just raised)

ex.en: We'll arrive there within an hour.

m.g: about that much; approximately that amount; thereabouts; (or) so

ex.en: Is she anywhere about?

m.g: and; and then; thus; and now

ex.en: I am planning to visit Kyoto, and Nara as well.

ex.ja: そちらはセントラル自動車学校ではないんですか。
ex.en: Isn't this Central Driving School?

ex.ja: そっちの生活はどうだい？
ex.en: How are things for you up there?

ex.ja: これとそちらとの違いは何だい。
ex.en: What is the difference between this and that?

m.g: exactly alike (e.g. in appearance); spitting image of; identical; strikingly similar

ex.ja: 計画はそっくり承認された。
ex.en: The plan was approved in its entirety.

ex.ja: あなたはお母さんにそっくりね。
ex.en: You look just like your mother.

ex.ja: 毎日、放課後に私はその本屋で彼女を待った。
ex.en: Every day I waited for her at the bookstore after school.

ex.ja: その後の話はご存じでしょう。
ex.en: You know the rest of the story.

and so forth; and the like; and what have you; et cetera

ex.ja: 何本か花がある。一本は赤、もう一本は白で、その他は黄だ。
ex.en: There are several flowers. One is red, another is white, and the others are yellow.

ex.ja: 私はその他の計画を思い付かない。
ex.en: I can't think of any other plan.

m.g: before very long; soon; someday; one of these days
of the previously mentioned; of that number; among them; among others

ex.ja: そのうち一緒に仕事ができるといいなと思っています。

m.g: in the first place; to begin with; from the start; originally

ex.ja: そもそもなぜ鳥は移動するのだろうか。
ex.en: Why do birds migrate in the first place?

ex.ja: そもそも事故の大半は熱帯雨林ではなく、身近な場所でおこるのである。
ex.en: Most accidents, after all, happen around the corner, not in the rainforest.

ex.ja: それが高1の時だから17年が経ちました。
ex.en: That was when I was in the first year at high school, so 17 years have passed since then.

m.g: that much; as much; to that extent; only that

ex.en: The higher you climb, the greater the fall.

ex.en: It was raining hard, so we played indoors.

ex.ja: あなたはリンゴが好きですか、それともオレンジが好きですか。
ex.en: Do you like apples or oranges?

ex.ja: それに、みんなに仲間もできるしね。
ex.en: And, we get each other's company to boot.

m.g: such; that sort of; that kind of; like that

ex.ja: そんなことを言う人は嫌いだ。

ex.ja: 彼はたかが政治屋だ。
ex.en: He is not any better than a politician.

m.g: only; merely; but; no more than

ex.ja: ここから歩いてたった１０分の距離です。
ex.en: It is no more than ten minutes' walk from here.

m.g: loosely; with room to spare; with enough space; (large) enough
a good (e.g. two weeks, ten kilometres); a full; at least; no less than

ex.ja: 教授の話はユーモアたっぷりだった。
ex.en: The professor's speech was full of humor.

ex.ja: まだ時間はたっぷりある。
ex.en: We still have plenty of time left.

ex.ja: 観客はたっぷりと５分間拍手した。
ex.en: The audience applauded for a full five minutes.

m.g: like I said; I told you already

ex.ja: １日中テニスをしていたのだから。

m.g: while it may be true that; just because; nevertheless; not necessarily

ex.ja: だからといって異議があるわけではない。

m.g: as much as; to the extent of; enough to

ex.ja: 来たのはメアリーだけだった。
ex.en: No one came except Mary.

ex.ja: この車には楽にその山をのぼるだけの力がある。
ex.en: This car has enough power to go up the mountain easily.

ex.ja: で、電話してみたらしいんだけど、その電話先の相手ってのが問題だったのよ。
ex.en: And so it seems she tried phoning but it's who was on the other end of that phone that was the problem.

m.g: to be lazy; to be slack; to feel dull; to feel languid

ex.ja: 蒸し暑いと心も体もだらける。
ex.en: Hot and humid weather makes us lazy.

ex.ja: 汗がダラダラです。
ex.en: I'm dripping with sweat.

ex.ja: 話は三時までだらだらと続いた。
ex.en: The talk dragged on till three o'clock.

m.g: sluggish; languid; listless; heavy (heart, legs, etc.)

ex.ja: だるいし頭がずきずきする。
ex.en: I feel listless and have a throbbing headache.

m.g: cancelling (a debt); forgiving (a debt); being even
forgetting (what was said or done); pretending (something never happened)

ex.ja: 謝ったんだから、さっきのはチャラにしてよ。
ex.en: I've apologised, so lay off, OK?

ex.ja: あら、あなたのところの娘のはるちゃんはとても陽気ですね。
ex.en: Oh, your daughter Haru is very cheerful.

ex.ja: この道具はちゃんと使えばとても役に立つ。
ex.en: If it is used properly, this tool will be a great help.

m.g: often; frequently; now and then; occasionally

ex.ja: ねずみが一匹、穴からちょこちょこ出てきた。
ex.en: A mouse scurried out of the hole.

m.g: chonmage; topknot hairstyle worn by men in the Edo period, and sumo wrestlers today
falling lightly (e.g. snow, petals, confetti); fluttering

ex.ja: ちょっと屈めば、信号旗がチラチラと見え隠れします。
ex.en: If you just crouch a little, the signal flag can just be seen flicking in and out of sight.

m.g: unintentionally; subconsciously; by mistake; against one's better judgement (judgment)

ex.ja: 私が彼を訪ねたのは、つい昨日のことだ。
ex.en: It was only yesterday that I called on him.

ex.ja: 彼の会社は私の会社のつい目と鼻の先にある。
ex.en: His office is very close to mine.

ex.ja: アッシュさんはついタバコを吸わずにいられないみたいですね。

ex.ja: あの新しい映画は、つまらんかった。
ex.en: That new movie was a bummer.

ex.ja: あの男はよくつまらぬことで誰にでも因縁をつける。
ex.en: He often uses the slightest thing as a pretext for a fight with anybody.

ex.ja: 私の父はビリヤードの玉のように頭がつるつるだ。
ex.en: My father is as bald as a billiard ball.

ex.ja: こんなデカイのがチャリの荷台に乗るわけないだろ。

ex.ja: では今晩またね、さようなら。
ex.en: See you tonight, then. Cheers!

ex.ja: 選挙では、保守派と革新派がせめぎ合った。

ex.ja: あの男がもう１つでも間違いを犯したらクビにする。
ex.en: If that man makes one more mistake, I'll fire him.

ex.ja: あなたはまるで幽霊でも見たような顔つきをしている。
ex.en: You look as if you had seen a ghost.

ex.ja: 冬に暖かい服装をしていないと、ひどいかぜをひくことになりかねない。
ex.en: If you don't wear warm clothes in winter, it wouldn't be surprising if you caught a bad cold.

ex.ja: 長時間歩くと踵にたこができる。
ex.en: If you walk a lot, you will develop calluses on your heel.

ex.ja: 注意しないと、問題に巻き込まれますよ。
ex.en: If you don't look out, you will get into trouble.

ex.ja: マルコーニさんとかいう人がご面会です。
ex.en: A Mr. Marconi wants to see you.

ex.ja: ところが実はどうすることもできないのです。

apart from ... (used to change the topic)

ex.en: She was captured trying to steal jewelry.

ex.ja: この雨の中を外出することはとてもできないことです。
ex.en: Going out in this rain is out of the question.

m.g: with a tap; with a knock; with a knocking sound; with a rap-tap

ex.ja: 彼女は指でテーブルをとんとんたたいた。
ex.en: She drummed her fingers on the table.

m.g: together with; as X, then Y (e.g. as we age we gain wisdom, as wine matures it becomes more valuable, etc.)

ex.en: It is so nice of you to give me a present.

ex.ja: お手数かけてどうもすいません。
ex.en: I'm sorry to bother you.

ex.ja: 「あの人たちは、またストをやるんだろうか」「どうもそうらしいね」

ex.ja: 彼は心臓がどきどき打っているのを感じた。

ex.en: Who is this, please?

ex.ja: あなたはそれらのうちのどれを選んでもよい。

ex.ja: あなたの鞄はどれですか。
ex.en: Which is your bag?

m.g: continuously; one after the other; in succession

ex.ja: だれかがドアをどんどんたたいている。

ex.ja: ある種の動物はどんどん数が減ってきている。
ex.en: Certain animals are fast disappearing.

no matter what (kind of); whatever; any; all

ex.en: What kind of places do you like?

ex.en: I'm opposed to any type of war.

ex.ja: どんな事が起こっても私は心を変えません。
ex.en: Come what may, I won't change my mind.

m.g: because; the reason is; if you want to know why
if; in case; if it is the case that; if it is true that
as for; on the topic of
if that's the case; if so; that being the case

ex.ja: 医者なら６桁の収入は珍しくない。
ex.en: A six-figure income is not uncommon for physicians.

m.g: something like ...; things like ...; someone like ...; the likes of ...

ex.ja: この仕事は決してやさしくなんかないんだよ。
ex.en: This work is anything but easy.

m.g: at (a time or place); in; on
in (a situation, matter, etc.); on (a point); when it comes to; regarding
on the part of; under the authority of; in the name of

ex.en: Salt was a rare and costly commodity in ancient times.

ex.ja: 英語は商業において役に立つ。
ex.en: English is useful in commerce.

ex.ja: この服は品質においてあの服よりもずっと優れていると思う。
ex.en: I think this suit is much superior to that one in quality.

ex.ja: １９９５年、安藤氏は建築におけるもっとも権威ある賞を受賞した。
ex.en: In 1995, Andou received architecture's most prestigious award.

ex.ja: この証拠は彼にとって不利だった。
ex.en: This evidence was against him.

m.g: according to; due to; by (means of); because of

ex.ja: 人の生活様式の大半はお金によって決まる。
ex.en: One's lifestyle is largely determined by money.

m.g: by means of; due to; because of; according to

ex.ja: ある研究によれば、ガンによる女性の死亡数の中では肺がんが１７％を占めている。
ex.en: A study shows lung cancer accounts for 17% of women's cancer deaths.

ex.ja: サムは仕事に関してまじめです。
ex.en: Sam is serious about his work.

ex.ja: そのことについては私に責任があります。

ex.ja: これは、ある猫についての物語です。
ex.en: This is a story about a cat.

m.g: towards; against; regarding; in contrast with

ex.ja: これが私の手紙に対する彼の返事だ。
ex.en: This is his answer to my letter.

m.g: material (for a story, article, etc.); information; news item

ex.en: What's your favourite type of sushi?

ex.en: If only I was younger.

ex.ja: ただ結果を待つのみだ。
ex.en: We can but wait for the results.

m.g: at leisure; in a relaxed manner; in a carefree manner; quietly

ex.ja: 退職したのでしばらくのんびり暮らすつもりです。
ex.en: I've retired and I'm going to take it easy for a while.

ex.ja: 日曜日はのんびりしています。
ex.en: We always take it easy on Sundays.

ex.ja: 「もしもし、ブラウンさんですか」「はい、そうです」
ex.en: "Hello, is this Mrs. Brown?" "Yes, this is Mrs. Brown."

ex.ja: はいどうぞ、君が飛行機の中で読む雑誌です。
ex.en: Here's a magazine for you to read in the plane.

m.g: to be clear; to be definite; to be certain; to be exact

ex.ja: そして書かれていることはすべて完全にはっきりと書かれている。
ex.en: And then everything that was written was completely clear.

m.g: only; merely; nothing but; no more than
as if to; (as though) about to; going to; on the point of

ex.en: I have about 5,000 yen.

ex.ja: あなたの妹はいつも自分の夫のことで文句ばかり言っている。
ex.en: That sister of yours is always complaining of her husband.

ex.ja: 「君はそれを終えたか」「とんでもない、始めたばかりだ」
ex.en: "Have you finished it?" "On the contrary, I've just begun."

m.g: perfectly; right on the mark; spot on; bang on

ex.ja: 彼女にばっちりキスされちゃったよ。

m.g: vigorously (ripping, tearing, scratching, etc.); roughly; with a rip

ex.ja: その秘密はついにばれた。
ex.en: The secret came to light at last.

ex.en: He works hard because he is anxious to succeed.

ex.ja: 風が吹くたびに、桜の花びらが、ひらひらと舞い降りてました。
ex.en: The cherry blossoms flutter down whenever the wind blows.

m.g: last (on the list); (at the) bottom; (in) last position; tailender

ex.ja: 彼はクラスでびりだった。
ex.en: He was at the bottom of the class.

m.g: with a rattle; with a shudder; trembling

ex.ja: 彼女は彼の手紙をびりびりに引き裂いた。
ex.en: She tore his letter to pieces.

ex.ja: ジェット機が建物の上を飛ぶと窓ガラスがびりびりした。
ex.en: When the jet flew over the building the windowpanes rattled.

ex.ja: 彼らは息がぴたりと合っている。
ex.en: They are a perfect match for each other.

ex.ja: メアリーは思いやりに欠けている。
ex.en: Mary is lacking in delicacy.

ex.ja: あの先生の講義はあくびが出る。
ex.en: His lectures are terribly boring.

ex.ja: 欠席された友人たちのために、乾杯しましょう。
ex.en: Let's drink to absent friends.

ex.ja: 欠点があるけどやはり彼が好きです。
ex.en: I love him despite his faults.

ex.ja: それは相互理解の欠如がもとになっていると思う。
ex.en: I think that is based on a lack of mutual understanding.

m.g: (not) ever; (not) by any means; (not) in the least; (not) in any way

ex.ja: アンディはけっしてデートにおくれたことはない。
ex.en: Andy is never late for a date.

m.g: to decide; to choose; to determine; to make up one's mind
to clinch (a victory); to decide (the outcome of a match)
to persist in doing; to go through with
to always do; to have made a habit of

ex.ja: そこに行くことに決めた。
ex.en: I made up my mind to go there.

m.g: decisive factor; clincher; key; trump card

ex.ja: ワインが食事の決め手です。
ex.en: Wine can make the meal.

m.g: to fix upon (one-sidedly); to (ignore someone's position and) arbitrarily decide something is the case
to scold; to take (a person) to task

ex.ja: 上司は僕の仕事振りがいい加減だと決め付けた。
ex.en: My boss took me to task for the poor quality of my work.

ex.ja: 彼女は私に自分の決意を知らせてくれた。
ex.en: She informed me of her decision.

m.g: settlement of accounts; closing accounts; financial results; reporting (of accounts)

ex.ja: その会社は毎年３月に決算をする。
ex.en: The company closes its books at the end of March.

ex.ja: 決勝まで残った走者は５人だった。
ex.en: Five runners reached the finals.

ex.ja: われわれは最終的決定を行った。
ex.en: We've made a final decision.

ex.ja: きっと無罪になるだけの決定的切り札を隠し持っているに違いない。
ex.en: I'm sure he has something up his sleeve.

m.g: pit; hollow; cavity; hole (e.g. in the ground)

ex.ja: そして各チームはボールを蹴ってこの穴に通そうと互いに競い合ったのです。
ex.en: And the teams competed with each other to try to kick the ball through this hole.

ex.ja: ミーティングに穴をあけてしまったことに対し、再度お詫びします。
ex.en: Let me apologize once again for missing our meeting.

m.g: to tie; to bind; to link
to close (e.g. deal); to confirm; to conclude

ex.ja: 彼らは都市を鉄道で結ぶことを計画中だ。
ex.en: They are planning to connect the cities with a railroad.

ex.ja: 実も結ぶが、挿し木でも根付くらしい？
ex.en: It bears fruit, but it seems it may even set root from cuttings?

m.g: consequently; as a result; hence; thus
as a result of; following; as a consequence of

ex.ja: 私達は息を殺して実験の結果を待った。
ex.en: We held our breath and waited for the result of the experiment.

ex.ja: 結果は気にするな。
ex.en: Don't worry about the results.

ex.ja: 結果、計算ミスが多い。
ex.en: There are a lot of results and a calculation mistakes.

m.g: after all; in the end; ultimately; eventually
end of a game of go, shogi, etc.

ex.ja: ゆっくりと着実なのが結局勝つ。
ex.en: Slow and steady wins the race.

m.g: not needing (any more of something); (already) having enough; fine (as in "I'm fine"); no, thank you

ex.ja: 好奇心がお旺盛なのは大変に結構なことである。
ex.en: A healthy curiosity is truly a fine thing.

ex.ja: どちらの日でも結構です。
ex.en: Either day is OK.

ex.ja: いや結構です。たくさんいただきました。
ex.en: No more, thank you. I'm full.

ex.ja: 結婚の申し込みが殺到した。
ex.en: Marriage proposals flooded in.

ex.ja: 彼らの結婚式に招待された。
ex.en: I was invited to their wedding.

m.g: conclusion (of an argument, discussion, study, etc.)

ex.ja: 二人は同じ結論に到達した。
ex.en: The two came to the same conclusion.

ex.ja: ナイフは血に塗れていた。
ex.en: The knife was covered in blood.

ex.ja: 私たちは血がつながっている。
ex.en: We are related by blood.

ex.ja: 宇宙船は月を回る軌道を外れている。
ex.en: The spaceship is out of orbit around the moon.

ex.ja: 彼は月に３０万円稼ぐ。
ex.en: He earns 300,000 yen a month.

m.g: moon viewing (esp. during the eight month of the lunar calendar)

ex.ja: 明日、月見の会があるだろう。
ex.en: They will have a moon-viewing party tomorrow.

ex.ja: 月食は珍しい現象だ。
ex.en: An eclipse of the moon is a rare phenomenon.

ex.ja: 月末に近づいている。
ex.en: The month is drawing to an end.

ex.ja: 国会は来週月曜に開かれる。
ex.en: The Diet will open next Monday.

ex.ja: 月曜日はいつも憂鬱だ。
ex.en: I always feel blue on Mondays.

ex.ja: 煙草をすうことは健康に悪い。
ex.en: Smoking is bad for the health.

ex.ja: 海辺の空気はきれいで健康的だ。
ex.en: The air by the sea is pure and healthy.

m.g: in good health; alive and well; going strong

ex.ja: 彼女の４人の姉妹のうち１人は他界したが、ほかは健在だ。
ex.en: One of her four sisters has passed away, but the others are still with us.

m.g: to be unable to; to find difficult (unpleasant, awkward, painful) to do
to serve two or more functions or roles simultaneously; to contain (or combine) two or more features
to work in two or more jobs simultaneously (positions, etc.); to do alongside
to hesitate to do something (out of consideration for others)

ex.ja: こういう事情ですから、残念ながら、せっかくのご招待をお受けいたしかねるのです。
ex.en: As such is the case, I am sorry I can't accept your kind invitation.

ex.ja: 今日は、ばーさんのお使いを兼ねて街で買い物。
ex.en: Today I'm shopping in town as well as running an errand for my grandmother.

ex.ja: 私は勉強と遊びを兼ねている仕事につきたい。
ex.en: I want to get a job that mixes work and play.

ex.ja: ケンとけんかしたのか。
ex.en: Did you have a fight with Ken?

m.g: inside (a region, area, etc.); within the range (of); within the sphere (of influence, etc.)
strong; firm (not viscous or easily moved)

ex.ja: 卵は硬くゆでてください。
ex.en: Boil the eggs hard.

ex.ja: このふたは固くて取れないよ。
ex.en: This lid is too tight for me to open.

ex.ja: その機械の骨組みは堅くなければならない。
ex.en: The frame of the machine should be rigid.

ex.ja: 「あなたは仕事が気に入っていると思います」「いやそれどころか、嫌いです」
ex.en: "I think you like your job." "On the contrary, I hate it."

ex.ja: ジムくんは行き過ぎの嫌いがある。
ex.en: Jim tends to go too far.

m.g: to hate; to dislike; to loathe; to abhor
to disregard; to act without regard (for)
to be bad for (e.g. dust in machinery)

ex.ja: 彼女は人前で話をするのを嫌う。
ex.en: She detests speaking in public.

ex.ja: この寺院は７８０年に建てられた。
ex.en: This temple dates back to 780.

ex.ja: その金は体育館の建設に当てられた。
ex.en: The money was appropriated for building the gymnasium.

ex.ja: 彼らは家の建築にとりかかった。
ex.en: They set about building a house.

ex.ja: 建築家は芸術家ぶってはならない。
ex.en: An architect should not pretend to be an artist.

ex.ja: あそこの建物が燃えているに違いない。
ex.en: That building must be on fire.

ex.ja: アメリカには憲法上の抑制と均衡という入念な制度がある。
ex.en: America has an elaborate system of constitutional checks and balances.

ex.ja: 世界の航空産業は墜落事故についての懸念を募らせている。
ex.en: The world's aviation industry is growing increasingly worried about crashes.

m.g: to turn over; to turn (pages); to leaf through (a book, etc.)
to tear off; to strip off; to take off; to pull off (e.g. a blanket)

ex.ja: 彼女はぼんやりと雑誌のページをめくっていた。
ex.en: She was idly turning over the pages of a magazine.

m.g: inspection (e.g. customs, factory); examination; test; check

ex.ja: 子宮癌の検査をしていただきたいのです。
ex.en: I'd like to have a Pap smear done.

m.g: looking up (e.g. a word in a dictionary); search (e.g. on the Internet); retrieval (of information); reference

ex.ja: 政府はその問題の決定案をまだ検索中だ。
ex.en: The government is still groping for a solution to the problem.

m.g: on-site inspection (by a judge, investigator, etc.) to gather physical evidence

ex.ja: この段階を踏まえ、抑圧という概念をさらに詳細に検証していくことになります。
ex.en: From this point we go on to an even more detailed examination of the concept of repression.

ex.ja: 私たちはその件を詳細に検討した。
ex.en: We debated the matter at length.

ex.ja: あなたにはそこに行く権利がない。
ex.en: You have no right to go there.

ex.ja: 王は権力を奪われた。
ex.en: The king was shorn of his power.

ex.ja: 彼女は吠える犬を怖がる。
ex.en: She is afraid of barking dogs.

ex.ja: 私はエイズの研究に従事している。
ex.en: I am engaged in AIDS research.

ex.ja: 紫外線の急激な上昇は研究者たちにオゾンホールの存在を信じさせた。
ex.en: The sudden increase of ultraviolet rays made the researchers believe in the existence of ozone holes.

ex.ja: 研修会は午後4時開始予定です。
ex.en: The training session is scheduled to begin at 4 p.m.

ex.ja: この美しいドレスは絹で出来ている。
ex.en: This beautiful dress is made of silk.

m.g: prefecture (of Japan); county (of China, Taiwan, Norway, etc.); department (of France); province (of Italy, Spain, etc.)

ex.ja: チューリップは、私たちの県の県花です。
ex.en: Tulips are our prefecture's official flower.

ex.ja: 肩が痛い。
ex.en: I have a pain in the shoulder.

m.g: to find out; to discover; to notice; to detect
to be wide-eyed (in surprise, anger, etc.)

ex.ja: 奴隷たちは宗教に活力を見いだす。
ex.en: Slaves find power in religion.

m.g: to be seen; to be visible; to be in sight
to look; to seem; to appear

ex.ja: １１ページの地図はとても奇妙に見える。逆さまにしてみると、見慣れた地図になる。
ex.en: The map on page 11 looks very strange. Turn it upside down. Then it becomes a familiar map to you.

ex.ja: 佐藤さんという方があなたの留守中にお見えになりました。
ex.en: A person named Sato came to visit while you were out.

m.g: to make (something or someone) look ...; to present an appearance of ...
to make (something) worth watching; to be entertaining
to have (something) looked at (by a specialist); to have (an antique, etc.) appraised

ex.ja: 彼女は背を高く見せるためにハイヒールをはいている。
ex.en: She wears high heels to make herself look taller.

ex.ja: 取り繕うように、笑ってみせる。
ex.en: She smiled to smooth things over.

ex.ja: どんな手を使ってでも勝ちとってみせる。
ex.en: I'll win no matter what it takes.

m.g: to see; to look; to watch; to view
to examine; to look over; to assess; to check
to look after; to attend to; to take care of; to keep an eye on
to experience; to meet with (misfortune, success, etc.)

ex.ja: １０ページの５行目をみなさい。
ex.en: Let's begin with the fifth line on page 10.

ex.ja: 頭がくらくらしているので、深く考えずにいい加減なことを書いてみる。
ex.en: My head is swimming, so I'll try writing any old stuff without any deep thought.

ex.ja: 私も親の面倒とか見られないですね。
ex.en: I can't look after my parents and such either.

m.g: to look at each other; to exchange looks
to correspond (to); to be proportionate (to); to be in keeping with; to offset

ex.ja: 三人の少年たちは互いに顔を見合った。
ex.en: The three boys looked at one another.

ex.ja: このお金であなたの要求に見合いますか。
ex.en: Will this amount of money meet your need?

ex.ja: 彼のスイングは実に見事だ。
ex.en: He has a perfect swing.

m.g: to watch over; to keep watch over; to keep an eye on
to watch intently; to stare; to gaze; to watch (and see what happens)

ex.ja: あなたの両親が私たちを見守ってくれました。
ex.en: Your parents kept an eye on us.

m.g: to look up at; to raise one's eyes
to look up to; to admire; to respect

ex.ja: 見上げると彼が入って来た。
ex.en: Looking up, I saw him come in.

m.g: to stare fixedly at; to fix one's gaze on
to make sure of; to set one's eyes on (e.g. the future); to focus on

ex.ja: 我々は将来を見据えつつ、今そこにある危機を乗り越えていかねばならない。
ex.en: We have to look the future straight in the eye and prepare to get through the coming crisis.

ex.ja: 選挙区の見直しの試みは、反対の壁にぶちあたりました。
ex.en: Attempts to redraw voting districts have hit a wall of opposition.

m.g: to look out over; to survey (scene); to take an extensive view of

ex.ja: この城から町を見渡すことができる。
ex.en: This castle overlooks the city.

m.g: to look at again; to re-examine
to prove oneself superior (to someone who had previously been condescending); to put a person to shame; to get one's own back

ex.ja: 驚いて彼女の顔を見返した。
ex.en: I stared back at her in surprise.

m.g: viewpoint; point of view; way of looking (at something); view
way of appreciating (e.g. opera); way of understanding; how to read (a map, train timetable, etc.)

ex.ja: 私の見方ではもう少し待つほうがよさそうだ。
ex.en: From my point of view, it would be better to wait a little longer.

ex.ja: その戦争は日本人の核兵器に対する見方に影響を与えた。
ex.en: The war affected the way the Japanese view nuclear weapons.

m.g: to liken (to); to compare (to); to imagine (something) as; to treat as
well-behaved (esp. children and pets); obedient; good

ex.ja: あなたは何と賢い生徒なのでしょう。
ex.en: What a clever student you are!

m.g: key (to a problem, success, etc.); clue

ex.ja: ドアを開ける際に、私は鍵を壊してしまった。
ex.en: In opening the door, I broke the lock.

m.g: (raw) material; ingredient; base; mix (e.g. for a cake)

ex.ja: 憲政の危機が始まったのは、このような状況のもとであった。
ex.en: It was under these circumstances that the constitutional crisis began.

ex.ja: やってしまったことは元に戻らない。
ex.en: What is done cannot be undone.

ex.ja: その事務員は過労がもとで死んだ。
ex.en: The clerk died from overwork.

m.g: lively; full of spirit; energetic; vigorous
healthy; well; fit; in good health

ex.ja: こんにちは、ロジャー。とっても元気よ。
ex.en: Hi, Roger. I'm pretty good!

m.g: (field) marshal; (fleet) admiral; general of the army

ex.ja: それで事故の原因が分かった。
ex.en: That accounts for the accident.

m.g: place of origin (of a plant or animal species, etc.); natural habitat; original home

ex.ja: じゃがいもは中南米高地が原産地である。
ex.en: The potato is native to the highlands of Central and South America.

m.g: nuclear power plant; nuclear power generation

ex.ja: 村人たちは原発反対の陳情をした。
ex.en: The villagers petitioned against the nuclear power plant.

ex.ja: 彼は厳しい批判にさらされた。
ex.en: He was subjected to severe criticism.

ex.ja: 練習がどんなに厳しくても、彼女は決して泣かなかった。
ex.en: However hard the training was, she never cried.

ex.ja: ツンドラ地帯の気候は厳しい。
ex.en: The tundra has a harsh climate.

m.g: to abate; to decrease; to diminish; to shorten

ex.ja: ジョギングでもして体重を減らすようにしなさい。
ex.en: Try to lose weight by jogging.

m.g: to decrease (in size or number); to diminish; to abate

ex.ja: 会員は５人に減った。
ex.en: The number of members decreased to five.

ex.ja: 彼は減税を唱えた。
ex.en: He advocated reduction of taxes.

ex.ja: トムが玄関にいるのでなかに入るように言ってください。
ex.en: Tom is at the door. Please ask him in.

m.g: to represent; to signify; to stand for
to reveal; to show; to display

ex.ja: ＆のマークはａｎｄの文字を表す。
ex.en: The sign "&" stands for "and".

ex.ja: ご自分の栄光を現された。
ex.en: He thus revealed his glory.

ex.ja: あなたのご親切に対し深く感謝の意を表します。
ex.en: I wish to express my deep appreciation for your kindness.

m.g: to appear; to come in sight; to become visible; to come out
to be expressed (e.g. emotions); to become apparent (e.g. trends, effects)

ex.ja: ２０人の警官が現場に現れた。
ex.en: Twenty police have arrived on the scene.

ex.ja: その薬の効きめが現れた。
ex.en: The medicine took effect.

m.g: cash; ready money; money on hand; currency

ex.ja: 現金で払う必要はありません。
ex.en: You don't have to pay in cash.

ex.ja: 私は現在の地位に満足している。
ex.en: I am content with my current position.

ex.ja: 現在、通常のサービスの早急な復旧に努めています。
ex.en: We are currently working to restore normal service as soon as possible.

ex.ja: 与党は５時現在で５０議席確保している。
ex.en: The ruling party has secured 50 seats as of 5 o'clock.

ex.ja: いい加減に現実をみつめろ。
ex.en: Open your eyes to reality.

ex.ja: イギリス人は現実的な国民であると言われている。
ex.en: The English are said to be a practical people.

ex.ja: この現象に関してはまだ物理的な説明がなされていない。
ex.en: There is not a physical explanation for this phenomenon yet.

m.g: actual spot; scene (of a crime, accident, etc.)
(on) site; (on) the ground; (in) the field; job site

ex.ja: 群衆が現場に群がった。
ex.en: A crowd gathered at the scene.

ex.ja: 報道機関は現職議員についてはいつもマル秘情報をつかんでいます。
ex.en: The press always has something on the incumbent.

m.g: present age; present day; contemporary; today
modern era; modern times; contemporary era

ex.ja: 私は現代の音楽はあまり好きではない事を認めます。
ex.en: I must admit I don't like much contemporary music.

m.g: actual place; actual location; the spot; the scene
place where one is currently living

ex.ja: 現地企業でのインターンシップを体験する。
ex.en: I'm going to do an internship at a local company.

m.g: student taking (university) entrance exams while still enrolled in school; student who passed their university entrance exams on the first try

ex.ja: 現役から引退した人は足が遠のくものだ。
ex.en: People rarely come to see you once you are retired.

m.g: to court; to woo; to approach defiantly
to begin to say; to start talking; to broach (a matter); to bring up
to be the first to say; to suggest (doing); to propose

ex.ja: マネージャーは、私が彼と一緒に空港に行ってはどうかと言い出した。
ex.en: The manager suggested that I go with him to the airport.

m.g: to spread (e.g. a rumor); to circulate; to disseminate
to declare; to assert; to state definitively
to finish saying; to say everything; to tell all; to finish one's sentence

ex.ja: 彼女は、自分は正しいと言い切った。
ex.en: She declared that she was right.

m.g: to talk back; to answer back; to retort; to reply
to say over; to repeat (what one has said)

ex.ja: ベスは言い返しましたが、お母さんは彼女にものすごく太りすぎていると注意しました。
ex.en: Beth protested, but her mother reminded her that she was incredibly fat.

m.g: way of saying (something); way of putting it; wording; phrasing

ex.ja: 私はそのような言い方をしたことが恥ずかしく思っている。
ex.en: I was ashamed of having said so.

ex.ja: ドイツ語はやさしい言語ではありません。
ex.en: German is not an easy language.

ex.ja: 「言葉の一面は、伝達しようとする意志である」と彼は言う。
ex.en: "One aspect of language is an intent to communicate," he says.

ex.ja: 言葉が出てこなかった。
ex.en: Words failed me.

ex.ja: 乱暴な言葉を使ってはいけない。
ex.en: Don't be rough in speech.

ex.ja: 言葉遣いにはいつも気をつけるべきです。
ex.en: You should always be careful in your speech.

m.g: as long as ...; as far as ...; as much as ...; to the limits of ...

ex.ja: 彼の好奇心には限りがなかった。
ex.en: His curiosity knew no bounds.

ex.ja: 私の力が及ぶ限り援助します。
ex.en: I'll help you to the best of my ability.

ex.ja: アキラはお金の続く限りニューヨークに滞在するだろう。
ex.en: Akira will stay in New York while his money lasts.

m.g: to restrict; to limit; to confine
to be restricted to; to be limited to; to be confined to
to be best (for); to be the best plan; to be the only way (to)

ex.ja: 金持ちが必ずしも幸福とは限らない。
ex.en: The rich are not always happy.

ex.ja: 暑い日は冷たいビールに限る。
ex.en: There is nothing like cold beer on a hot day.

ex.ja: あらゆるものに限界がある。
ex.en: There is a limit to everything.

ex.ja: 切符の数は限定されていた。
ex.en: The number of tickets was limited.

m.g: counter for years (of age difference); counter for school-years

ex.ja: この懐中電灯は２個の電池が必要だ。
ex.en: This flashlight needs two batteries.

ex.ja: この部屋は個人専用です。
ex.en: This room is for individual use.

ex.ja: あなたとちょっと個人的に話をする必要がある。
ex.en: I'd like to have a word with you.

ex.ja: 彼はすばらしい個性を持っている。
ex.en: He has a wonderful personality.

ex.ja: 彼女は非常に個性的な人だ。
ex.en: She has a very strong personality.

ex.ja: ケンが使っている机はもう古い。
ex.en: The desk that Ken uses is old.

m.g: old times; a long time ago

ex.ja: 歌舞伎は古くからの日本の芸術だ。
